statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-34980 (GHSA-4852-v58g-6cwf): in OpenPrinting CUPS 2.4.16 and earlier, a network-exposed cupsd with a shared PostScript queue accepts an unauthenticated Print-Job whose page-border value keeps an embedded newline through option escaping, so the reparsed option is trusted as a PPD line and can lead to code execution as the lp user. It is fixed in CUPS 2.4.17 by https://github.com/OpenPrinting/cups/commit/8d0f51cac24cb5bf949c5b6a221e51a150d982e3: https://github.com/OpenPrinting/cups/security/advisories/GHSA-4852-v58g-6cwf. The DHI cups packages for Alpine 3.23 are published at 2.4.13-r0, 2.4.16-r0, 2.4.18-r0 and 2.4.18-r1 for x86_64 and aarch64; the cupsd program in each reports CUPS 2.4.13, 2.4.16, 2.4.18 and 2.4.18. 2.4.13-r0 and 2.4.16-r0 are builds of CUPS releases that predate the fix, and Alpine records this CVE as fixed in its 2.4.18-r0 package. 2.4.18-r0 is built from CUPS 2.4.18, which contains the fix, so it is the first fixed build.

CVE-2026-34980 (GHSA-4852-v58g-6cwf): in OpenPrinting CUPS 2.4.16 and earlier, a network-exposed cupsd with a shared PostScript queue accepts an unauthenticated Print-Job whose page-border value keeps an embedded newline through option escaping, so the reparsed option is trusted as a PPD line and can lead to code execution as the lp user. It is fixed in CUPS 2.4.17 by https://github.com/OpenPrinting/cups/commit/8d0f51cac24cb5bf949c5b6a221e51a150d982e3: https://github.com/OpenPrinting/cups/security/advisories/GHSA-4852-v58g-6cwf. Debian lists trixie's 2.4.10-3+deb13u2 as vulnerable and fixes it in 2.4.17-1 for unstable: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-34980. DHI publishes four rebuilds of Debian's cups 2.4.10-3+deb13u2 for Debian 13 (amd64 and arm64), and the Debian changelog shipped in the cups-daemon package of each of them records the backport of the upstream fix for CVE-2026-34980. The lowest of those rebuilds is the fixed version in this range; earlier builds that are no longer in the repository are treated as affected.
